meet.speaker: Pip
text: (sniff)... Are you a grown-up? You look like a grown-up.
I can't find my way home. Home has a lantern on it. And my sister. I think I had a sister.

help.speaker: Pip
help.text: Really? Her light was orange. Like a sunset that stayed.

ignore.speaker: Pip
ignore.text: ...Okay. I'll just wait here. I'm good at waiting.

waiting.speaker: Pip
waiting.text: Did you find her? Orange light. Like a sunset that stayed.

charm.speaker: Pip
text: That's... that's HER light! I remember! Mira! My sister is Mira!
I can see the way now. Thank you, {player}. I won't forget you. I promise I won't.
